description: Create a new post in the esa team. Requires a title and optionally accepts content, tags, category, WIP status, and other metadata. Returns the created post information including the assigned post number and URL.

message.description: Commit message for the post update.

name.description: Post title (required). Use # for # and / for / if needed in title.

tags.description: Array of tags to be attached to the post.

template_post_id.description: Template post ID to apply to this post.

wip.description: Whether the post is in WIP (Work in Progress) state. Defaults to true.

name: create_post
